topic.label: Art Practice
topic.desc: Art Practice: making contemporary art across drawing, painting, sculpture, photography, new media and performance, with critique and professional practice.

concepts: Observational and expressive drawing using line, value, perspective and the figure.
Painting in oil, acrylic and watercolour with attention to colour theory, surface and composition.
Three-dimensional work in clay, wood, metal and found materials, and site-specific installation.
Still and moving images made with cameras, from exposure and lighting to editing and sequencing.
Digital, interactive and time-based art including sound, code, projection and live performance.
Studio critique, artist statements, portfolios, exhibitions and grants.
skills: Sets an observational drawing exercise and checks the result for proportion, value range and perspective accuracy.
Constructs one, two and three point perspective for a scene and checks vanishing points and horizon consistency.
Guides timed gesture and figure studies and checks anatomy and proportion against reference.
Plans a limited palette and mixing strategy and checks value and hue relationships with a value study.
Advises on oil, acrylic or watercolor technique such as glaze and fat over lean and checks material safety and permanence.
Develops thumbnail compositions for a painting and checks balance, focal point and value structure.
Plans materials, joins and tools for a sculpture and checks the plan for structural soundness and shop safety.
Specifies a mold and casting process in plaster, resin or metal and checks steps against safety data.
Designs an installation for a given site and checks dimensions, load and audience flow against site constraints.
Sets exposure and lighting for a shoot and checks the result with histogram and test frames.
Edits and sequences a photo or video series and checks narrative flow with a peer critique pass.
Guides film developing and printing and checks chemistry, timing and ventilation against safety guidance.
Prototypes an interactive or generative artwork in code and checks it runs reliably for the intended duration.
Designs sound and projection for an installation and checks levels, throw distance and sync on site.
Writes a score for a time-based performance and checks timing, roles and documentation plans with a rehearsal.
Runs a structured critique of a work and checks that feedback addresses intent, form and context.
Drafts an artist statement and checks it for clarity and consistency with the portfolio work.
Assembles a portfolio and grant application and checks documentation and requirements against the call.
